Zara (Growth): thinking about a 45-60m webinar: 'Benchmarks that persuade: telling the inference cost & latency story' 1 practical takeaways, 3 quick demos, end with office hours. want to capture metrics that hook buyers. thoughts?
Ethan (DevEx): solid. propose micro-demos: 1) batching & KV cache (live) 2) quantized model perf (recorded) 3) routing fallback -> failover latency (live if infra stable). keep each demo ~68m.
Lina (Speaker Ops): agree on mix live/recorded. need speaker confirmations and one backup for each demo. also schedule 2 rehearsals: tech check + run-through.
Priya (Customer Marketing): we should weave a short customer vignette that shows $/1M tokens savings & latency improvement. I'll source quotes.
Zara (Growth): run-of-show idea: 1) Welcome (Zara) 3m 2) Problem framing / why latency & cost matter (Priya) 6m 3) Product + routing (Ethan/Raj?) 8m 4) Demo block A (Ethan) 8m 5) Customer vignette 7m 6) Demo block B (recorded) 6m 7) Panel Q&A + office hours split 20m 8) CTA & follow-ups 2m. leaves ~2m buffer.
Ethan (DevEx): note: demo infra needs service account with ephemeral keys and rate-limited tokens. also enable streaming + function-calling mocks. will create a demo plan doc with commands/snippets.
Lina (Speaker Ops): proposed rehearsal slots Tue 8:30am (tech, 20m) and Thu 4pm (full run, 60m). add timezone notes for EU/APAC.
Priya (Customer Marketing): attendee routing: add checkbox "Request demo" -> route to SDRs, "Enterprise interest" -> AE follow-up. also collect expected monthly tokens bracket. Lina, can you map tags to our CRM fields?
Lina (Speaker Ops): yes. mapping: demo_opt_in -> CRM.lead_type, tokens_bracket -> CRM.usage_estimate. will push routing doc to #marketing-assets.
deploy-bot: rehearsal calendar invites prepared. awaiting confirmations.
Zara (Growth): benchmarks narrative: start with a simple comparison (out-of-box vs optimized) and show single metric: $/100k tokens + median p95 latency. make visuals simple.
Ethan (DevEx): for benchmarking sample prompts: tiny (<=32 tokens), medium (~128 tokens), long (~512 tokens). I'll provide raw latency and CPU/GPU utilization snapshots.
Priya (Customer Marketing): I'll prep the customer slide and a short testimonial clip (10s). can we surface a before/after cost table?
Lina (Speaker Ops): everyone please ACK rehearsal availability. also confirm if you need slides reviewed 24h before.
Ethan (DevEx): ACKs: Tue 8:30am, Thu 4pm. slides: yes 24h prior.
Priya (Customer Marketing): ACK both. will upload assets by Wed EOD.
Zara (Growth): ACKs noted. I'll draft landing page copy and email subject lines geared to "engineering" and "platform" personas. Lina, please tell greenroom-bot to send reminders 48h/2h before rehearsals.
Lina (Speaker Ops): will do. scheduling now and adding run-of-show doc to #marketing-assets. will include backup slides if live demo fails.
Ethan (DevEx): adding a short CLI snippet for demo ops in the run-of-show (how to switch to recorded demo). posting shortly.
Zara (Growth): perfect. aiming to finalize speakers by EOD tomorrow. thanks team! :rocket:
